Chapter 466: Chapter 10 Where is Huailong Palace, Give Me a Direction (Please Subscribe)_2

Of course, even for an Immortal King Seed, stepping into the realm of an Immortal King is extremely difficult. Having hope is one thing, but Cangqing Immortal didn’t believe that Lin Yuan was already a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

From the Unity Path Stage to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, it is as vast as the heavens. Cangqing Immortal had a deep understanding of this. Despite having overcome the Mind and Spirit Tribulation and ranking as a Half-Step Immortal King, he knew deep down that there was no possibility of him becoming an Immortal King in this lifetime.

At most, before the end of his lifespan, Cangqing Immortal could attempt to transcend the Bodily Tribulation. Even if he failed, it would be within expectations.

“However, if this young one has already reached the Half-Step Immortal King, wouldn’t that relieve some pressure off Huailong Palace?”

Suddenly, an idea struck Cangqing Immortal.

When he had negotiated with Lin Yuan, he agreed to allow the spread of Martial Tao in the Lower Realms, and that Martial Dao Cultivators who reached the Sixth Rank could ascend to the Spirit Realm via the Ascension Platform, as well as receive protection.

...

In return, Lin Yuan would help the Daode Immortal Sect once within his capabilities.

Of course, Lin Yuan could refuse, and Cangqing Immortal was quite lenient about this, as, after all, he had not given much.

“So be it.”

“It has been a long time since I went out.”

“This time I’ll go see how that young one from back then is doing.”

Cangqing Immortal slowly stood up, and his figure disappeared from its original spot.

As for the large-scale decisive battle that Huailong Palace wanted to initiate, a battlefield of such scale required a lot of preparation time. It would not start within at least ten years.

…

Xianyao City, Martial Temple.

The silhouette of Cangqing Immortal appeared silently.

“Lifting the restrictions on Martial Tao?”

Cangqing Immortal glanced at the recent happenings inside Xianyao City and generally grasped the situation.

Step by step, Cangqing Immortal walked towards the depths of the Martial Temple. Around him lingered layers of illusionary realms. As a Half-Step Immortal King who had passed the Mind and Spirit Tribulation,

if Cangqing Immortal wished, it would be difficult for even someone at the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Peak like Li Qing to detect his presence.

Having passed the Mind and Spirit Tribulation, Cangqing Immortal had greatly enhanced his soul, easily concealing and twisting others’ perceptions.

“Seems like there’s no change.”

“Has that young one really returned?”

Cangqing Immortal arrived at the Martial Temple Hall, looked around casually, and didn’t notice anything out of the ordinary.

Just as Cangqing Immortal was considering whether to reveal himself and inquire with Li Qing,

Hum.

The surrounding void became illusionary.

Scenes unfolded layer by layer as Cangqing Immortal reappeared outside Xianyao City, as if everything he had experienced was just an Illusionary Realm.

“What?!”

Cangqing Immortal’s pupils constricted, and his heart was overwhelmed by a surge of emotions.

Illusionary Realm?

He, a mighty Half-Step Immortal King who had passed the Mind and Spirit Tribulation, had unknowingly fallen into an Illusionary Realm?

Although in terms of combat power, a Half-Step Immortal King who had passed the Mind and Spirit Tribulation was not as strong as one who had passed the Bodily Tribulation,

when it came to mastering the Soul Illusion, a Half-Step Immortal King who had passed the Bodily Tribulation could not hold a candle to one who had passed the Mind and Spirit Tribulation.

Now, however, Cangqing Immortal had unwittingly experienced an Illusionary Realm. Were it not for the other party intentionally dispersing the Illusionary Realm, Cangqing Immortal would probably still be immersed in it.

“This is terrifying.”

“What kind of Illusionary Realm was that…”

Cangqing Immortal’s spirit trembled. To casually play with a Half-Step Immortal King like him using a Soul Illusion,

Cangqing Immortal had a guess in his mind.

“Could it be…” Cangqing Immortal steadied his spirit and entered Xianyao City once again.

This time, without using any skills, Cangqing Immortal simply walked down the streets and eventually arrived behind the gates of the Martial Temple.

Hesitating for a moment, Cangqing Immortal spoke to the guardian, “My name is Cangqing, here to visit… to visit the Martial Ancestor.”

“Come in,” said the guardian as if he had already received the order, leading Cangqing Immortal to stop in front of the Martial Temple Hall.

Cangqing Immortal paused for an instant and eventually walked into the Martial Temple Hall.

The Martial Temple Hall at this moment, compared to what Cangqing Immortal had experienced before, was no different.

The only change was that there was a figure sitting in the main seat.

The figure was a young man. Although he was just sitting there, Cangqing Immortal felt as if he was facing the vast Spirit Realm itself.

“It’s been a long time…” Lin Yuan looked at Cangqing Immortal and slightly smiled.

“You… Are you really Jun Wuji?” Cangqing Immortal was momentarily stunned. If before, he had only speculated that a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King was within the Martial Temple and that only an exalted Immortal King could effortlessly make him fall into an Illusionary Realm without knowing,

then now, upon seeing Lin Yuan, Cangqing Immortal was almost certain of his earlier speculation, and that the Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King was indeed that young one from before—

Jun Wuji.

“You could say so,” Lin Yuan nodded with a smile. Although in a different body, his True Spirit Consciousness was the same, making this similar to the reincarnation of a True Immortal of the Merged Path.

“Jun Wuji…” The name stirred tremors in Cangqing Immortal’s heart.

Even though he had long regarded Jun Wuji as a genius of the Immortal King Seed level,

facing the now truly Immortal King Jun Wuji, Cangqing Immortal still felt an inner tumult.

Immortal King!

That was a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King!

Even those who were hopeful to become an Immortal King, the seeds of an Immortal King,

were only hopeful to become one. Perhaps, among dozens of Immortal King seeds, there would be one who could become an Immortal King, right?

“Take a seat.”

“Don’t just stand there.”

Lin Yuan said casually.

When Cangqing Immortal approached Xianyao City, Lin Yuan had already sensed him.

Later, when he found out that Cangqing Immortal intended to sneak into the Martial Temple undetected, Lin Yuan conveniently dragged him into the Illusionary Realm.

It was a sort of greeting.

“Yes.”

“No, I’d rather stand.”

Cangqing Immortal quickly reacted, not daring to take a seat.

What a joke!

To sit with a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King?

Cangqing Immortal was acutely aware of his own status; he wasn’t Lin Yuan’s junior, nor had he conferred any significant favors on Lin Yuan.

The only thing he did right was that over the years, he had always kept his promises, but that was what he ought to do.

At this moment, Cangqing Immortal felt immensely relieved. After Jun Dongjin and others ascended to the Spirit Realm thousands of years ago, some in the Immortal Sect voiced their opposition and wished to stop favoring the Jun Family with resources.

Back then, Cangqing Immortal directly refused them.

Firstly, the resources allocated to the Jun Family were but a drop in the ocean for the Daode Immortal Sect at that time, and Cangqing Immortal didn’t care about the myopic concerns of those people in the sect over such matters.

Secondly, Cangqing Immortal was still looking forward to Jun Wuji’s ascension to the Spirit Realm.

As time passed and after Cangqing Immortal’s unreserved refusals, other people in the sect dared not bring up the matter again.

“You have done well these years,”

Lin Yuan nodded. At least he did no injustice to the people of the Jun Family and had protected the Martial Dao Evolutionary Path.

“It’s my duty, my duty,”

Cangqing Immortal immediately replied.

From Lin Yuan’s words, he realized that the other party knew all that he had done over the years.

Because of this, Cangqing Immortal was even more afraid. Had he made even a slight mistake back then, he would probably be facing the wrath of a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King right now.

Indeed, such wrath was something that neither the entire Xuanwang Domain nor Dongyun Tao Province could bear.

“Speak.”

“What do you want me to help with?”

Lin Yuan asked directly.

The Daode Immortal Sect had treated the Jun Family well and protected the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

As part of the negotiation conditions, he needed to lend a hand if it was within his power.

“What kind of help?”

Upon hearing this, Cangqing Immortal’s spirit suddenly surged.

Almost instantly, Cangqing Immortal thought of asking Lin Yuan to help him through the Bodily Tribulation.

But as soon as this thought emerged, Cangqing Immortal dismissed it.

Whether it be Mind Tribulation or Bodily Tribulation, external forces had almost no effect—one had to rely on oneself.

Otherwise, why would Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings be so rare in the Spirit Realm? Not to mention others, the offspring and friends of those kings should have been able to step into the stage of Tribulation Transcendence too.

From this, one can deduce that even an Immortal King could hardly interfere with Bodily Tribulation or Mind Tribulation.

Even if one could intervene, it would come with a dire price, not in line with the ‘within my power’ he had promised.

“I hope…”

Countless thoughts flashed through Cangqing Immortal’s mind. In his life, other than himself, the thing he cared most about was the Daode Immortal Sect.

Currently, the biggest crisis facing the Daode Immortal Sect was the Huailong Palace.

Against the Huailong Palace Master who had transcended the Bodily Tribulation, Cangqing Immortal couldn’t think of any way to deal with him.

“I hope that the Martial Ancestor could intervene in the Huailong Palace matter,”

Cangqing Immortal steadied his mind and spoke respectfully.

“Huailong Palace, huh…”

Lin Yuan nodded. Even if Cangqing Immortal hadn’t mentioned it, he wouldn’t have let the Huailong Palace go.

According to Li Qing, it was the mighty ones of Huailong Palace who had gravely injured Jun Dongjin back then, which led to his failed breakthrough later on.

Lin Yuan rose to his feet and walked out of the Martial Temple Hall.

Cangqing Immortal followed immediately.

“Martial Ancestor, the Huailong Palace is a heritage of the Water Tribe’s dragon descendants, and its master has the True Dragon Bloodline. He should have transcended the Bodily Tribulation…”

“And there’s the Jiujang Domain… it’s said to be related to a Tribulation-Transcending Dragon King…”

Cangqing Immortal quickly briefed Lin Yuan on the strength of Huailong Palace.

But halfway through,

Lin Yuan interrupted him.

He asked directly:

“Where is Huailong Palace? Give me a direction.”
